# 功能│Function
在安裝這個資料包之前，終界龍不免疫來自玩家的傷害以及爆炸傷害（傷害類型：```#is_explosion```）；當你安裝了這個資料包，終界龍將不免疫任何來自生物的傷害以及爆炸傷害。│Before installing this data pack, the ender dragon is not immune to damage from players and explosions (damage type: ```#is_explosion```); after you install this data pack, the ender dragon will not be immune to any damage from mobs and explosions.
# 注意事項│Precautions
該資料包透過名為"immune_to_non_mob_damage"的自訂附魔來實現此效果，因此如果您在創造模式物品欄中看到帶有"toxin_accumulation"附魔的附魔書，請忽略它。│The datapack achieves this effect via a custom enchantment called "toxin_accumulation", so if you see an enchanted book with the "immune_to_non_mob_damage" enchantment in your Creative Inventory, please ignore it.
